patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layouts are frequently used for section introductions, pairing a large, bold heading with a smaller, descriptive paragraph to its right.

A clear typographic hierarchy is established with oversized, bold sans-serif headings for main sections, contrasted with lighter weight body text and very small, uppercase labels for categories or sub-sections.

Mastercard's signature red, orange, and yellow gradient is strategically applied as a vibrant accent for branding elements, call-to-action buttons, and key visual highlights against a predominantly neutral off-white and dark gray palette.

The hero video container dynamically scales down and increases its corner radius as the user scrolls, while the main navigation bar simultaneously transforms from a transparent, integrated state to a distinct, smaller, sticky bar with a light background and rounded end caps.
Content is frequently presented within large, rounded-corner image cards, often featuring subtle text overlays or integrated calls-to-action, to showcase various services, insights, and experiences.

technique_notes: A hero video is presented within a large, full-bleed container that dynamically scales down and increases its corner radius as the user scrolls, revealing content below.

The primary navigation bar transitions from a transparent, overlaid state within the hero to a compact, sticky bar with a solid, light background and dark text, featuring rounded end caps, as the user scrolls past the hero section.
Content sections below the hero are revealed with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation effect as they enter the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, lighter body text and very small, uppercase labels for categories.
design_tokens.radius: Very rounded for the hero video container and prominent image cards (large radius, ~20-30px), with subtle rounding for buttons and smaller elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy in the hero and main section headings, transitioning to a balanced density for content grids, creating an open and inviting feel.

standout: The dynamic, transforming hero video container and navigation bar on scroll is distinctive, elegantly transitioning from an immersive brand statement to a functional content browsing experience. This is complemented by the consistent use of large, rounded-corner image cards that give the site a soft, approachable yet bold aesthetic.
